# SfAutoComplete — Public API

**Namespace:** `Syncfusion.Blazor.Toolkit`  
**Primary type:** `SfAutoComplete<TItem>`

> **Contract status:** This is the proposed public API for a future component. No `SfAutoComplete` implementation or shipped public API baseline is present in the repository at this revision; signatures and runtime behavior below are design requirements, not claims about a released assembly. Phase 2 members are explicitly deferred.

---

## 1. Component

```razor
<SfAutoComplete TItem="Country"
                Data="@countries"
                @bind-Value="@selected"
                @bind-Text="@text"
                DisplayTextFunc="c => c.Name"
                FilterType="AutoCompleteFilterType.Contains"
                DebounceInterval="300"
                MinLength="0"
                ForceSelection="false"
                Placeholder="Search country"
                ClearButton="true" />
```

## 5. Models

The model and event-argument types below describe the proposed Phase 1 API. `AutoCompleteSearchContext` and `AutoCompleteValueChangedEventArgs<TItem>` are not public API: there is no corresponding public parameter/event, so they are intentionally omitted from both this inventory and the test claims.

```csharp
public sealed class AutoCompleteItemContext<TItem>
{
    public TItem Item { get; init; }
    public string Text { get; init; }
    public bool IsActive { get; init; }
    public bool IsSelected { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyList<AutoCompleteTextSegment> MatchSegments { get; init; }
}

public sealed class AutoCompleteTextSegment
{
    public string Text { get; init; }
    public bool IsMatch { get; init; }
}

public class AutoCompleteOpenEventArgs { public bool Cancel { get; set; } }
public class AutoCompleteCloseEventArgs { }
public class AutoCompleteSearchEventArgs { public string Query { get; init; } }
public class AutoCompleteItemSelectedEventArgs<TItem>
{
    public TItem Item { get; init; }
    public string Text { get; init; }
}
```

## 6. CSS class & data-testid contracts

See Spec.md §9 and §13. Public class names are stable for customization.

## 7. Public API inventory (checklist)

- `SfAutoComplete<TItem>`
- `Value`/`Text` bind, `TextChanged`, and `ValueExpression` for EditContext field identity
- `Data`, `SearchFunc`, `FilterType`, debounce, min length, max items
- `ForceSelection`, clear, disabled, readonly
- Templates: Item, NoResults, Header, Footer, Loading
- Events: Open, Close, Search, ItemSelected, Clear
- Methods: Open/Close/Focus/Blur/Refresh/Clear
- Enums: FilterType, OpenOn
- ItemContext + match segments
- `Name`, `AriaLabel`, `AriaLabelledBy`, and `TabIndex`
- `MaxLength`, `ShowPopupButton`, and `OpenOn` policy
- Header/Footer/Loading templates; `FocusAsync`, `BlurAsync`, `ClearAsync`

`EnableVirtualization`, `ItemHeight`, `PopupHeight`, `GroupBy`, `PrefixTemplate`, and `SuffixTemplate` are Phase 2 proposals, not Phase 1 capabilities. `Autofill` is not a parameter or public member.

## 8. Normative behavior and sample alignment

Use the behavior contract in `Spec.md` §§3–6. In particular: `SearchFunc` wins over `Data`; a missing `CustomFilter` yields no local matches for `FilterType.Custom`; invalid `TextField` configuration is surfaced rather than silently falling back; search exceptions use Blazor error handling; `OnSearch` is raised immediately before source execution; `OnOpen` is pre-transition and cancellable; `OnClose` is post-transition; `HighlightFirstItem` does not autofill.

| Order | Sample | Description |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Default | Type-ahead selection from a local list with clear support for common form fields. |
| 2 | Remote data | Debounced asynchronous search with cancellation and loading state for directory-style lookups. |
| 3 | Templates | Customize suggestion rows, empty state, and popup chrome with match highlighting. |
| 4 | Force selection | Compare required list selection with free text and form validation. |
| 5 | Large list | Type-ahead over a large local collection with a suggestion limit; virtualization is Phase 2. |
| 6 | Form and states | Validation, disabled and read-only states, and right-to-left layout for production forms. |
